title: US, European stocks fall as Iran war drives oil rally, bond selloff
author: Sigma Capital
metaDescription: US and European stocks fell, bond yields climbed, and oil prices rose amid ongoing concerns over the Iran war. Markets reacted to Trump's pause in hostilities a
excerpt: US and European stocks fell, bond yields climbed, and oil prices rose amid ongoing concerns over the Iran war. Markets reacted to Trump's pause in hostilities and progress in talks. Stock declines were driven by heightened geopolitical tensions.

content.introduction: US and European stocks fell, bond yields climbed, and oil prices rose amid ongoing concerns over the Iran war. Markets reacted to Trump's pause in hostilities and progress in talks. Stock declines were driven by heightened geopolitical tensions.

NEW YORK/LONDON, May 19 (Reuters) – A global stock index fell as U.S. bond yields rose again on Tuesday, while oil prices eased as investors digested the latest headlines on U.S. talks with Iran to end the war. Trump on Monday said he had paused a planned resumption of hostilities following a new proposal by Tehran to end the U.S.-Israeli war. U.S. Vice President JD Vance said the United States and Iran have made a lot of progress in their talks and neither side wants to see a resumption of the military campaign.
